titleEn: View orders, search, filter, order timeline

en: What is the status of order 1234?

edgeCases: Customer PII: assistant masks phone/address in logs
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Team member lacking the permission gets 403: assistant states who can do it (store owner) instead of retrying
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
